name: parser-ambiguity
description: M4 S7 scenario, parser rejection and ambiguity (docs/evidence/M4/SCENARIO-BACKLOG.md row 2). Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000 = 1977-12-12 12:00:00 UTC, zone UTC, microseconds 0, as house-boot). RDCOM (77rooms.mud:600) reads each line, LEX (77rooms.mud:1559) splits it into at most 10 upper-cased words truncated to 5 letters, EPARSE (77np.mud:347) -> SPARSE (77np.mud:19) -> SYN-MATCH (77np.mud:144). At West of House: an unknown word (`xyzzy`, `I don't know the word XYZZY`), a real but odd verb (`frobozz`), an empty line (`Beg pardon?`, no move: INPLEN 0) and a line of blanks (`Huh?`, a move), the 5-letter truncation (`inven`, `inventoryxyz`) and upper case (`INVENTORY`), a buzz word alone (`the`: `Huh?`), a bare noun (`mailbox`: `What should I do with the mailbox?`, which leaves an orphan whose OSLOT1 the next verb picks up: `take` -> ORFEO -> `Nice try.`), `take it` (IT is a buzz word: `Take what?`, ORTELL), an adjective without a noun (`open brass`: `Dangling adjective?`), an adjective that does not fit (`take wooden mailbox`: `I can't see a woode mailb here.`, PRSTR prints 5-letter names), three objects (`Too many objects specified?`), two prepositions (`Double preposition?`), a quoted word (LEX's QUOT skips a slot, so `take "leaflet"` is `take`), eleven words (LEXV holds 10; the 11th is dropped silently), `northeast` (truncated to NORTH, a direction). Then round the house (east, open window, west), into the dark attic (`up`; `take knife`: `It is too dark in here to see.`) and back, to the living room; `move rug` shows the trap door, so `door` names two visible objects (WDOOR and DOOR): `open door` -> GET-OBJECT returns NEFALS -> `Which door?` (ORPHAN T OPEN <> <> DOOR), answered by the adjective `trap` (SPARSE's ADJ branch substitutes the orphan's noun; the trap door opens); again `open door` -> `Which door?`, an unknown word in between (the orphan survives a failed parse), then `wooden` (`The door cannot be opened.`); mixed case `Take BRASS Lantern`; `take all` over several objects; `score` (33 moves for 34 lines: the empty line is not a move). Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/PARSER-AMBIGUITY-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies). Not used: `help`/`info`/a leading `?` (OPEN "READ", strict by maintainer decision).
